POL-HORS-PERIMETRE-V1.title: FIXEO Universal Scope-Change Protocol
POL-HORS-PERIMETRE-V1.scope: ALL métiers — applies whenever actual intervention differs from declared scope

base_protocol.description: Universal workflow when reality differs from declared booking scope. No work beyond declared scope may begin without client approval.

prohibitions: No price modification because artisan considers work harder, unless objective frozen escape trigger applies

pre_steps: MAKE_SAFE — isolate circuit before any investigation
AUTHORIZATION_CHECK — verify occupancy right before proceeding
REFRIGERATION_INTEGRITY — if leak found, halt recharge until leak repaired
MOISTURE_SOURCE_RESOLUTION — if active moisture present, stop and identify plumbing/structural source first
peinture.note: Painting over active moisture is a HARD exclusion

POL-MINIMUM-NON-ADDITIVE-V1.title: FIXEO Minimum Floor Non-Additive Rule
POL-MINIMUM-NON-ADDITIVE-V1.scope: Métiers with explicit minimum floor: bricolage (200), nettoyage (200), peinture (800), menuiserie (300)

content.anti_additive: MINIMUM FLOOR IS NEVER ADDITIVE. It is a price floor. The floor is never added to the service price.
content.serrurerie_clarification: 220 MAD (porte_claquee_ouverture) is an approved service price, NOT a métier floor. serrurerie.minimum_floor = null.

disclosure_sequence: 1. IDENTIFY — determine required hardware during assessment
2. DISCLOSE — name the part and provide reference price range
3. EXPLAIN — clarify that this is separate from the FIXEO labour price
4. QUOTE — state the actual price to be charged for this part
5. OBTAIN_APPROVAL — client must explicitly agree before ordering/installing
7. DOCUMENT — record part name, price, and approval
prohibited_practices: Silently bundling hardware into labour price
Charging premium markup on client-supplied parts
Refusing to service client-supplied compatible parts without stating technical reason

cap_rules.plomberie_consumables: ≤50 MAD included (seals, thread tape). Exceeding this triggers disclosure.
cap_rules.electricite_consumables: ≤15 MAD included (connectors, wire). Exceeding triggers disclosure.
cap_rules.menuiserie_consumables: Minor screws/lubricant included. Hardware (hinges, runners) always separate.

POL-DIAGNOSTIC-ABSORPTION-PLOMBERIE-V1.title: Plomberie Diagnostic Absorption Rule
POL-DIAGNOSTIC-ABSORPTION-PLOMBERIE-V1.scope: plomberie.diagnostic (180 MAD) — absorption against same-visit qualifying repairs

absorption_conditions.absorption_mechanism: Diagnostic fee credited against repair price for that same visit
Diagnostic fee credited against standardized repair price for that same visit

content.source: electricite/registry.v0.3.json D3 rule — frozen, not extended

POL-DIAGNOSTIC-ABSORPTION-CLIM-V1.title: Climatisation Diagnostic Absorption Rule
POL-DIAGNOSTIC-ABSORPTION-CLIM-V1.scope: CLIM-002 (250 MAD) — absorption against same-visit qualifying interventions

absorption_conditions.absorption_mechanism: Diagnostic fee credited against qualifying intervention price same visit

content.mandatory_pre_step: MAKE_SAFE — isolate circuit (cut power at disjoncteur or fusible) before any investigation, removal, or replacement
content.onee_boundary: ONEE limiteur de puissance and réseau ONEE infrastructure are HARD exclusions — redirect to ONEE (0801 00 20 20)
content.earth_ground_verification: Required before certifying any new installation
content.hard_exclusion_trigger: is_onee_equipment = true → ROUTE to ONEE, no further intervention

POL-SERRURERIE-AUTHORIZATION-V1.title: Serrurerie Occupancy Authorization Protocol
POL-SERRURERIE-AUTHORIZATION-V1.scope: ALL serrurerie opening and replacement services

content.mandatory_pre_step: AUTHORIZATION_CHECK — verify occupancy right before any intervention
content.hard_exclusion: Cannot proceed without verifiable occupancy right. Ambiguous cases: STOP and EXPLAIN.
content.no_minimum_floor: This policy does not establish a minimum floor. serrurerie.minimum_floor = null.

content.no_blind_top_up: PROHIBITED to top up refrigerant without first diagnosing and repairing any leak
content.mandatory_pre_step: If leak suspected: STOP recharge, diagnose source, repair or declare hors périmètre
content.r32_boundary: R32 refrigerant requires specialist certification. Non-certified artisan must ROUTE to R32 specialist.
content.r22_phase_out: R22 is phased out. Document if R22 system found; advise client of replacement options.

POL-CLEANER-HOUR-V1.title: Nettoyage Per-Cleaner-Hour Semantics
POL-CLEANER-HOUR-V1.scope: NET-002 and all nettoyage hourly calculations

three_distinct_bases.painted_m2: Wall painted area — used for PEIN-002/003/005. Not equal to floor area.
three_distinct_bases.ceiling_m2: Ceiling area — used for PEIN-004. Measured directly.
three_distinct_bases.floor_m2: Floor area — NOT used as pricing basis for any peinture service.

content.conversion_status: RESEARCH_ESTIMATION_ONLY — floor-to-painted conversion factor (~1.6-2.0×) is not validated for production
content.estimator_rule: Estimator V1 must request painted_m2 directly. Do NOT implement automatic floor→painted conversion until factor is human-validated.
content.active_moisture_exclusion: HARD EXCLUSION — if active moisture source detected on wall to be painted: STOP, identify source (plomberie/structural), complete moisture resolution first

content.aluminium_excluded: Aluminium fabrication is a DEFERRED specialist métier — not in menuiserie scope

POL-BRICOLAGE-BOUNDARY-V1.title: Bricolage Métier Boundary Policy
POL-BRICOLAGE-BOUNDARY-V1.scope: All bricolage services — defines what is and is not in scope

content.worker_semantics: Single artisan (1 worker). MUST NOT be confused with nettoyage team semantics.
